memberdef.definition: cl::opt< bool > ConvertToLocal("avail-extern-to-local", cl::Hidden, cl::desc("Convert available_externally into locals, renaming them " "to avoid link-time clashes."))
memberdef.argsstring: ("avail-extern-to-local", cl::Hidden, cl::desc("Convert available_externally into locals, renaming them " "to avoid link-time clashes."))
memberdef.name: ConvertToLocal

briefdescription.para: Create a copy of the thinlto import, mark it local, and redirect direct calls to the copy.

detaileddescription.para: Only direct calls are replaced, so that e.g. indirect call function pointer tests would use the global identity of the function.

Currently, Value Profiling ("VP") MD_prof data isn't updated to refer to the clone's GUID (which will be different, because the name and linkage is different), under the assumption that the last consumer of this data is upstream the pipeline (e.g. ICP).
